blocks.content: While padding adds space inside the border, margin adds space outside the border, separating one element from another.

Horizontal margins, like padding, work on all elements. However, vertical margins (top and bottom) only apply to block elements. To add a vertical margin to an inline element, like a link, you'll need to change its display type to block.
